verdict.rationale: Kit exposes a full REST API with API-key and OAuth auth, bulk/async endpoints with callback URLs, and webhooks for event-driven automation, all of which are usable non-interactively in scripts or CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/headless-execution documentation, no CLI, and no first-party example of running Kit workflows inside a CI system. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples or a CLI/headless mode, dedicated CI integration guides, independent confirmation of automated pipeline use.
